Experienced Interior Architectural Designer (8+ years of experience)
COOKFOX Architects is seeking a creative Interior Architectural Designer (8 or more years of experience) to lead the design and execution of highly crafted, award-winning interior spaces collaboratively with our senior interior architects. The position focuses on the interior architectural scope and includes the selection of finishes and fixtures, the development of architectural and millwork details, and the coordination of trades including MEP and lighting. Candidates should have an expressed interest in working in a collaborative studio environment and a passion for environmental sustainability.
Key Responsibilities:
Qualifications and Skills:
COOKFOX Architects is a New York City-based studio dedicated to integrated, environmentally responsive design. Inspired by concepts such as biophilia and biomimicry, we are pursuing architecture that restores and regenerates. Our mission and our deep sense of responsibility to design environments that foster the well-being of the planet and people are intrinsically tied to our commitment to social justice. We advocate for diversity, equity, and inclusion within our studio, projects, communities, and society.
We believe that the best design emerges from the collective work of a diverse community of designers. We maintain a studio environment that encourages collaboration, design input, learning, and open communication across all experience levels and roles on project teams. Our studio supports professional development through active mentorship programming, on-going education and training opportunities, and support for licensure and certifications.
The annual salary range for this position is $90,000-$110,000, determined by the candidate’s experience and qualifications.
All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender-identity, or national origin.
Please visit COOKFOX.com to learn more about our mission, projects and studio culture.
Please submit resume and portfolio to [email protected] with “Experienced Interior Architect” in the subject line. Please do not send attachments exceeding 5 MB. No phone calls, please.
